fixes: Lines 2, 4 and 6 are the recipe commands of the target named on the 'update target' line just above them (line 1 -> 2, 3 -> 4, 5 -> 6). The commands table has no link back to that target, so a command cannot be tied to the target it builds. Carry the target down from the most recent update line into each command row as a `target` column; a target can have several recipe lines, so do not just merge commands into the updates row. This needs a format-2 parser.

Lines 0 and 7 are not decoration. 'Entering directory' names the directory that every update and command up to the matching 'Leaving directory' runs in. In recursive builds (make[1]:, make[2]:) the same 'Makefile:6' or target name can occur in several directories. Stop skipping the Entering line: carry its quoted path down as a `directory` column on both the updates and commands rows until the matching Leaving line. Also carry the make level from the `make[N]` prefix, if present, as a column. This needs a format-2 parser.

examples:
make: Entering directory '/tmp/mk'
Makefile:6: update target 'main.o' due to: main.c
cc -c main.c -o main.o
Makefile:6: update target 'util.o' due to: util.c
cc -c util.c -o util.o
Makefile:4: update target 'app' due to: main.o util.o
cc -o app main.o util.o
make: Leaving directory '/tmp/mk'
